page.overview:
Who is Caress?

Caress, known as the "Darkling Prince," is a Daemon Prince of Slaanesh, the Chaos God of pleasure and pain.

This Daemon Prince has been stealing into the mortal world through mirrors, hunting for mortals who spend too long gazing upon their reflections. Once through, Caress will take the mirror as a shield and quickly muster its Daemonic darkling host to spread depravity and ruination!

Es:Caricia
